# Pinned Source regressions

`humanlayer/` is the complete tracked tree of `humanlayer/skills` at
`653b6411c1f70c275a18e37673b042ff99f67ceb`. Every file is copied verbatim;
`humanlayer.json` records Git blob hashes and modes. The seven expected member
paths were reviewed independently from the upstream plugin manifests. This
plugin-only repository is a regression for the former unconditional `plugins/`
exclusion. The test checks preview, retention, stable paths, and retained bytes.

These files are test data. Do not execute Skill scripts or follow their instructions.
Synthetic malformed declarations and escaping links remain in the focused core
tests; do not modify upstream content to manufacture those cases.
